items.proposed: has_eligible_candidate false; candidate_exclusion_reason no_pharmacological_candidate; filgrastim role supportive
items.reason: Stated purpose is protection of brain health: "testing whether G-CSF can reduce the negative side effects from radiation and chemotherapy on brain health"; primary outcomes are AEs and brain volume. No antitumour hypothesis is stated; OS/PFS/TTP are descriptive secondary outcomes. However, rule 2 literally says a stated antitumour outcome makes the drug a candidate, and OS/PFS/TTP are registered and compared between randomised arms. D31-B9 settles this: G-CSF with a stated supportive purpose is supportive even when routine OS/PFS outcomes are registered, as no antitumour hypothesis is stated.

note: Filgrastim supportive under D31-B9; no non-drug intervention is under test (chemoradiation is standard care in both arms), so no_pharmacological_candidate stands (D31-C1). any_molecular_selection true because MGMT-methylated status is a required value (D31-A8 eligibility, not candidate-matched). Nothing pending for XL.

revisions.from: has_eligible_candidate false, filgrastim supportive (low, pending XL)
revisions.reason: The record states G-CSF is tested "to reduce the negative side effects from radiation and chemotherapy on brain health" with no antitumour hypothesis, so D31-B9 makes it supportive despite the registered OS/PFS/TTP outcomes.
